## Courses Taught (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign)

* IS 204: Research Design for Information Sciences (online, 3 credit hours): Spring 2026.

* IS 568: Accessibility in HCI Seminar (graduate seminar, 4 credit hours; newly developed): Spring 2025.

* IS 407: Introduction to Data Science (4 credit hours): Spring 2022 (in person); Fall 2022, Spring 2023, Fall 2023, Spring 2024, and Fall 2024 (online).

* IS 226: Introduction to Human-Computer Interaction (online, 3 credit hours; co-taught with Dr. Yang Wang): Fall 2021.

* Teacher Ranked as Excellent by Their Students, Center for Innovation in Teaching and Learning: Spring 2022, Spring 2024, Fall 2024, and Spring 2025.

## Curriculum Development

* Designed and launched IS 568: Accessibility in HCI Seminar, a new graduate course (Spring 2025).

* Developed accessibility modules for IS 226: Introduction to Human-Computer Interaction (Fall 2021) and a GitHub-organization-based workflow for IS 407: Introduction to Data Science (Spring 2022).

## Professional Development Teaching

* Non-Visual Data Science Course for Blind Individuals, Smith-Kettlewell Eye Research Institute (Summer 2023, 2024, and 2025): organized and delivered professional development on non-visual data science for blind individuals: https://www.ski.org/projects/empowering-data-vision-data-science-course-blind-individuals
